_purpose: Wave-6 (MX-J) assembly knobs.  Byte-identical to the wave-5 (MX-I) knob file, which is itself identical to waves 1-3's, deliberately: the whole wave measures what happens when the wave-5 survivors are installed TOGETHER, so the only thing allowed to differ between a wave-5 isolation cell and its wave-6 composed step is the composition.  A knob change here would make every comparison in the frontier table a comparison between two experiments.
_calibration_tolerance_note: Unchanged from NOTES-MX-D 4 / MX-E / MX-F / MX-G / MX-I: the evidence base is captured with a bfloat16 parent, so the sealed activation rows carry ~2^-9 relative quantization and the copy_exact calibration arm cannot beat that floor.  Waves 1-3 measured 0.000638-0.002282 across every component that could run the gate.
